mapper.select: SELECT player_type FROM t_group_union_member WHERE player_id=#{playerId} AND union_id=#{unionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_group_union_member(`union_id`, `player_id`, `inviter_id`, `player_type`, `from_group_id`, `create_time`, `bonus`) SELECT #{unionId}, player_id, #{playerId}, (CASE WHEN player_type=0 THEN 4 WHEN player_type=1 THEN 5 ELSE player_type END), #{groupId}, #{now}, (case when player_type=0 then #{bonus} else bonus end) FROM t_player_group WHERE group_id=#{groupId}
